tagline: One of the most intense seasonal short-hop ferry markets on earth — Ibiza↔Formentera — plus a marquee luxury base.
summary: The Ibiza↔Formentera crossing is among the densest short-hop ferry markets in the Mediterranean: a ~5 nm leg run continuously all summer by Baleària, Trasmapi and Aquabus, feeding Formentera's beaches and beach clubs. Layered on top is an intense HNW nightlife-and-luxury market (Marina Ibiza, Marina Botafoch) and villa/yacht transfers. The short distance and overwhelming seasonal volume make it a high-frequency Pioneer II case.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the Ibiza↔Formentera crossing (~6 nm), the Ibiza coast and Sant Antoni, plus marina tenders.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) links Ibiza to Mallorca (~75 nm) and the mainland.

competitive_landscape: Baleària, Trasmapi and Aquabus run one of the Med's densest short-hop ferry markets; a heavy charter/villa fleet operates alongside. Summer crowding is the pain. No foiling incumbent.
seasonality: Extremely seasonal — the market is concentrated May–Oct and largely empties in winter.
regulatory_note: Spanish flag / EU; Balearic port authority (APB); Formentera enforces summer vehicle caps that push demand to the water — a tailwind.
